_note: Commercial-state source of truth for category readiness. A category is 'open' only when its FULL pathway is operational (limits, methods, laboratory capacity, decision rules, agreements, mark controls, surveillance, verification) — never merely because a standards page exists. 'private_readiness_only' requires a published technical standard a brand can be ready against; a category whose standard is still in development is 'evidence_review', not private-readiness. States are set from the on-disk standards data (content/standards/*.md `type` + firm analytes) and data/manuals/manifest.json, verified 2026-08-13; regenerate content/category-readiness.md with tools/build-category-readiness.mjs after any change.
